name: Cable sheath both-end bonding arrangement
aliases: switchyards Switchyard earthing and lightning interfaces
summary: Shows the assigned earth bonds at both ends of the documented cable sheath circuit.
description: Shows the assigned earth bonds at both ends of the documented cable sheath circuit. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Cable sheath ends” at the input and “Earth bonds at both ends” at the output. Circulating sheath currents require assessment.
